如何选择合适的后台任务类型（短时任务、长时任务、延迟任务、代理提醒）
如何申请和使用短时任务执行状态保存等短暂操作
如何申请长时任务实现后台音乐播放和导航
如何使用延迟任务执行数据同步等非实时性操作
如何实现闹钟、倒计时和日历提醒等代理提醒功能
如何合理使用后台硬件资源避免进程被系统终止
如何处理应用退至后台后进程被挂起或终止的问题
当应用退至后台后仍需要继续执行任务时，请使用Background Tasks Kit选择合适的后台任务类型
当应用需要保存状态或执行短暂的实时性任务时，请使用短时任务
当应用需要长时间在后台运行用户可感知的任务（如音乐播放、导航、位置追踪）时，请申请长时任务
当应用有实时性要求不高但需要最终执行的任务（如数据同步、日志上传）时，请使用延迟任务
当应用需要在退后台或进程终止后仍能按时发出提醒（闹钟、倒计时、日历提醒）时，请使用代理提醒功能
当音视频应用需要实现后台播放时，需要同时接入AVSession Kit和Background Tasks Kit的长时任务
实现应用切到后台后继续上传文件 / Keep file uploads running after the app goes to the background
保存草稿时申请短时后台任务避免切后台被中断 / Use a transient background task to finish saving a draft when the app is backgrounded
接入后台播放让音频离开前台后持续运行 / Enable background playback so audio keeps running outside the foreground
实现后台导航定位持续更新 / Keep navigation and location updates running in the background
用延迟任务在夜间批量同步数据 / Schedule deferred tasks to batch sync data overnight
把非实时刷新改成系统调度的后台同步任务 / Move non-urgent refresh work to system-scheduled background sync
添加闹钟和倒计时到点提醒 / Add alarm and countdown reminders that fire at the scheduled time
实现日历事件的代理提醒通知 / Create agent reminders for calendar events
管理后台任务的申请、取消和执行状态 / Manage background task requests, cancellation, and execution state
处理应用退到后台后下载被暂停的问题 / Handle downloads being paused when the app moves to the background
在锁屏或应用退出前完成关键数据落盘 / Finish persisting critical data before lock screen or app exit
控制后台任务使用定位音频等资源避免被系统杀死 / Control background use of location or audio resources to avoid being killed by the system
do_not_use_when: 需求只是实现页面生命周期、前后台状态感知或Ability启动流转，应改用 ability-kit / If the need is only page lifecycle handling, foreground-background state awareness, or Ability launch flow, use ability-kit instead

需求只是编写通用ArkTS语法、Promise/定时器或基础并发逻辑，而非申请系统级后台任务，应改用 arkts / If the need is only general ArkTS syntax, promises/timers, or basic concurrency logic rather than requesting system-managed background tasks, use arkts instead
需求是构建界面、提醒展示样式或用户交互页面，而不是让任务在后台继续执行，应改用 arkui / If the need is to build UI, reminder presentation, or interaction pages rather than keep work running in background, use arkui instead

需求是卡片持续展示信息或通过卡片触发轻量交互，而不是管理后台运行时长，应改用 form-kit / If the requirement is persistent widget display or lightweight widget-triggered interaction rather than managing background execution time, use form-kit instead

需求是进程间通信、跨Ability消息传递或远程服务调用，而不是短时/长时/延迟任务调度，应改用 ipc-kit / If the requirement is inter-process communication, cross-Ability messaging, or remote service calls rather than short/long/deferred task scheduling, use ipc-kit instead

需求是云端或服务端函数编排、定时工作流与后端自动化，而非设备本地后台任务，应改用 function-flow-runtime-kit / If the need is cloud/server-side function orchestration, scheduled workflows, or backend automation rather than on-device background tasks, use function-flow-runtime-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已集成并可访问Background Tasks Kit相关SDK接口 / The app has integrated and can access the Background Tasks Kit SDK APIs
模块配置已声明所选后台任务类型所需的权限与能力，并通过校验 / The module configuration has declared the permissions and capabilities required by the selected background task type and passed validation
若所选任务类型需要用户可感知能力或系统授权，相关授权已获得 / If the selected task type requires user-visible capability or system authorization, the required consent has been granted
inputs: 后台任务类型 / background task type
任务配置参数（如开始/结束时机、延迟条件、提醒时间） / task configuration parameters (such as start/end timing, delay conditions, reminder time)
任务执行逻辑或回调 / task execution logic or callback
任务标识或提醒标识 / task ID or reminder ID

postconditions.statement: 代码已显式选择并接入一种合适的后台任务机制（短时任务、长时任务、延迟任务或代理提醒） / The code explicitly selects and integrates an appropriate background task mechanism (short-term, long-term, deferred task, or agent reminder)
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show that one specific Background Tasks Kit mechanism was chosen and wired into the app code rather than only adding generic comments or timers?

postconditions.statement: 后台任务的启动、注册或请求逻辑已写入应用代码并与业务场景关联 / The background task start, registration, or request logic is implemented in app code and tied to the business scenario
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there concrete code that starts, registers, or requests the background task/reminder and connects it to the intended feature flow?

postconditions.statement: 若任务需要配置项或权限，工程中已补充对应配置或声明 / If the task requires configuration or permissions, the project includes the corresponding configuration or declarations
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include the necessary configuration or permission declarations when the chosen background task type requires them?
